name: Colombia IDEAM river level stations (datos.gov.co)
short: IDEAM river level readings at stations on Colombian rivers, hourly, via the national open-data portal. Free, no key.
summary: Colombia's national weather and environment institute (IDEAM) publishes instantaneous river level (water surface height, metres) from its automatic hydrology stations as an open dataset on datos.gov.co (Socrata, SODA JSON API). Each record has station code and name, department, municipality, hydrographic zone, latitude, longitude, sensor description, unit and the observed value with its time. The description says the level is monitored, recorded and transmitted hourly, and that the data are raw readings from station sensors, not validated by IDEAM; update frequency is stated as daily. A keyless GET sorted by time on 2026-11-07 UTC returned readings stamped 2026-11-06 23:59 local time (El Bagre, Nechi river, 3.97 m). Sibling datasets for minimum and maximum river level were not checked.

tasks: station metadata with coordinates, department and hydrographic zone

coverage.notes: Colombia only; stations on the main river basins. Station count was not measured.

rate_limit.notes: Socrata platform; no number checked. Unauthenticated Socrata calls can be throttled; an app token is optional and was not used.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07 UTC with order by fechaobservacion desc: newest record 2026-11-06T23:59 local, so under a day old. Metadata says the dataset updates daily; rowsUpdatedAt 2026-11-07.

latency.notes: Dataset update frequency is stated as daily in the metadata, so this is near-real-time, not minutes.

licensing.summary: Dataset metadata on datos.gov.co: Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0 International (credit IDEAM; derivative datasets must carry the same licence). Provenance flagged official. The description says the data are raw, unvalidated readings from automatic stations, free to consume under stated clauses. The portal's own terms of use were not read. Automated access, AI training and resale are not addressed.
